scope: Read-only trace of smal-ai dispatch to azurelocalbox, human clarification, final review and origin completion handback

timelineUtc.summary: Confirmed discovery complete and accepted, but platform readiness not established

rootCause.classification: Missing native completion handback for standalone origin-tagged execution requests
rootCause.request: Backend records originAgentId/originConversation/originNodeId, but this request is not a formal delegated child of a waiting parent execution.
rootCause.review: execution.review completes the execution and task and persists its event, but does not create an origin completion notice.
rootCause.consumption: NodeJournal.consume creates addressed notices only for question.ask/question.forward. Execution events update target work but do not enqueue origin completion delivery.
rootCause.delivery: tickAgentNotices handles addressed questions only. tickNode skips terminal executions. Formal waiting_children continuation does not apply to this root request.
rootCause.notLost: The approval and result are retained. The missing action is an automatic notification/wake of smal-ai, not a failed review or missing result.

recommendedFix: Persist a distinct origin-completion notice, keyed to execution and exact result/review revision, for completed, rejected, failed or cancelled origin-tagged standalone requests.
Deliver only through the authorised exact origin binding with busy deferral, native settlement and uncertainty fencing. Do not silently retarget a replacement chat.
Do not notify successful completion before required human review. Do not treat a review reason such as Please continue as new execution authority.
Reconcile offline/restart/snapshot recovery without duplicate messages and without duplicate wakes for formal parent/child continuation.
Expose pending/blocked handback state and add an end-to-end dispatch, clarification, review, origin-wake regression.
releaseLimitation: RC3 retains this completion-handback gap. Its CI and packaging checks do not certify this missing workflow.
